Title: Survey of graph database models
Problem addressed: How to classify and compare graph data models
Method: Literature survey and comparison of models
Key result: Gives a framework for comparing graph models and their query support
Limitation / gap: Predates property-graph standards and modern engines

Title: Foundations of modern query languages for graph databases
Problem addressed: What can graph query languages express and at what cost
Method: Survey of language features and formal results
Key result: Systematic overview of pattern, path and reachability querying

Title: Cypher: An evolving query language for property graphs
Problem addressed: Describe the design and semantics of Cypher
Key result: Documents Cypher's pattern matching, incl. variable-length patterns

Title: Knowledge graphs
Problem addressed: Overview of knowledge-graph models, tools and uses
Key result: Covers RDF and property-graph views of knowledge graphs

Title: Graph pattern matching in GQL and SQL/PGQ
Problem addressed: Formalise pattern matching shared by GQL and SQL/PGQ
Method: Formal semantics of the shared core
Key result: Gives a common formal core for the two new standards

Title: GPC: A pattern calculus for property graphs
Key result: Provides a formal pattern calculus (GPC) unifying graph pattern matching and path semantics
Limitation / gap: Theoretical framework; lacks empirical systems benchmarking

Title: PG-Schema: Schemas for property graphs
Key result: Proposes PG-Schema, a comprehensive schema language for property graphs aligned with ISO GQL
Limitation / gap: Focuses on formal schema syntax; no database engine performance evaluation

Title: ISO/IEC 39075:2024 GQL
Key result: First standard graph query language

Title: ISO/IEC 9075-16:2023 SQL/PGQ
Key result: Extends SQL standard with Part 16 (SQL/PGQ) to execute graph pattern queries on relational tables
Limitation / gap: Emerging standard; open-source RDBMS implementations (PostgreSQL) are still evolving

Title: Demystifying graph databases: analysis and taxonomy of data organization, system designs, and graph queries
Key result: Taxonomy of data organisation, system designs and queries

Title: Graph Databases (2nd ed.)
Key result: Explains index-free adjacency and Neo4j storage

Title: The future is big graphs: a community view on graph processing systems
Key result: Lists challenges across graph processing and storage

Title: Kuzu graph database management system
Problem addressed: Design of an embedded analytical graph DBMS
Key result: Presents design choices for analytical graph queries
Limitation / gap: Research prototype; not Neo4j or PostgreSQL

Title: A+ indexes: tunable and space-efficient adjacency lists in graph DBMSs
Method: Index design in a graph DBMS
Key result: Shows adjacency indexes can be tuned for workloads

Title: Making RDBMSs efficient on graph workloads through predefined joins
Problem addressed: Make a relational engine fast on graph queries
Key result: Shows relational engines can be sped up on join-heavy graph queries
Limitation / gap: Needs engine changes; not stock PostgreSQL

Title: Worst-case optimal join algorithms
Key result: Join algorithms matching worst-case output bounds
Limitation / gap: Theory; our queries are not cyclic patterns

Title: A comparison of a graph database and a relational database: a data provenance perspective
Problem addressed: Compare graph and relational DB on provenance data
Key result: Early benchmark showing Neo4j traverses relationships faster than MySQL as depth increases
Limitation / gap: Outdated versions (Neo4j 1.0, MySQL 5.1) and small synthetic provenance dataset

Title: Do we need specialized graph databases? Benchmarking real-time social networking applications
Problem addressed: Compare graph and relational systems on social workloads
Key result: Reveals that specialized graph engines do not uniformly outperform relational systems on social benchmarks
Limitation / gap: Evaluates older DBMS versions; relational baseline used naive unoptimized joins

Title: The LDBC Social Network Benchmark: interactive workload
Key result: Defines the interactive workload

Title: LSQB: a large-scale subgraph query benchmark
Key result: Provides a subgraph-query benchmark

Title: The LDBC Social Network Benchmark: business intelligence workload
Key result: Defines complex analytical graph queries

Title: PostgreSQL 16 documentation: WITH queries (CTEs)
Key result: Defines recursive CTE evaluation and UNION semantics

Title: Cypher manual, version 5
Key result: Defines variable-length pattern semantics

Title: SPARQL 1.1 Query Language
Key result: Defines SPARQL 1.1
